Subject: Pilot scope & procurement checklist — identifying economic buyer

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of the call
- Objective: 6-week pilot to validate Redwood inference latency/cost for GreenCity’s triage assistant.
- Success criteria: median tail latency < 300ms for 95th percentile, cost target <$0.003/token, and measurable improvement in triage throughput.

Immediate asks for you
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer who owns budget for triage tooling? (title + best email)
2) Procurement contact for contracts and SOW (name/email) and any purchase order process or templates we should know about.
3) Security contact to kick off the questionnaire (SOC2 evidence, data flow diagram).

What we’re sending now
- Attached: redwood-pilot-onepager.pdf (pilot scope + metrics)
- Attached: procurement-checklist.xlsx (what we typically need from procurement)

Planned Redwood actions
- We’ll draft a one-page SOW stub and send to procurement for timeline alignment. (Ben will own the draft.)
- Marissa will schedule a 30-min intro with the engineering sponsor and your security lead.

Proposed timeline
- Confirm buyers/contacts by end of week (10/16)
- Draft SOW shared 10/14
- Security questionnaire kickoff week of 10/19

If it helps, I can loop in our legal and solutions engineers on the next thread.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this tight.

—
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot scope & procurement checklist — identifying economic buyer

Hi Laura — great to meet you yesterday. Quick answers below.

Economic buyer / budget owner
- Michael Raghavan, VP, Clinical Operations (michael.raghavan@greencityhealth.io). He signs off on vendor pilots that touch triage workflows.

Procurement
- Procurement lead: Mark Davis (mark.davis@greencityhealth.io). He handles SOWs and PO intake. Typical procurement timeline is 2–3 weeks for small pilots, longer if there are custom SLAs.

Security / compliance
- Security mailbox: security@greencityhealth.io — for the SOC2 questionnaire and any evidence. Please send the filled questionnaire and a short data flow diagram.

Note on decision criteria from our side
- Primary: measurable latency improvement with predictable cost per ticket.
- Secondary: data residency + access controls.

I’ll introduce Michael on a separate thread after you send the SOW stub. We prefer an email intro so he has the context.

Thanks,
Sophie
Head of Product Partnerships
GreenCity Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: GCH pilot - outreach plan for econ buyer & procurement

Marissa / Ben —

Sophie confirmed the econ buyer (Michael Raghavan) and procurement (Mark Davis). Proposed division of labor: 

- Ben: please draft a concise SOW stub (~1 page) focused on pilot scope, success metrics, timeline, and the minimal SLA items. Aim to have a draft by COB 10/14 so we can send to Mark on 10/15. Attach the procurement checklist as an appendix.

- Marissa: once the SOW is ready I’ll introduce you to Michael and Sophie for an executive-level 20–30 minute alignment. We want to make the ask clear: approval to proceed with the pilot and a sense of budget authority.

- I’ll own procurement intro to Mark and the security kickoff to security@greencityhealth.io.

Risks / flags:
- If procurement requests a custom SLA beyond our standard pilot terms, that could push timeline into Nov.
- Security might ask for redacted DB schemas — confirm what is acceptable to GCH.

Ben: please include an explicit line item for \"pilot termination & data deletion\" to satisfy security.

Thanks — short and practical.

—
Laura
